news.title: Venkatesh's Family Drama Kickstarts Promotions With Festive Song
news.summary: The musical campaign for the upcoming Victory Venkatesh starrer Aadarsha Kutumbam - AK47 has officially commenced with the release of its first single, Narayanamma. Composed by Thaman S, the energetic celebration track features glamorous dance moves by Dimple Hayathi alongside Venkatesh, Srinidhi Shetty, and Nivetha Pethuraj. Directed by Trivikram Srinivas and produced by S. Radha Krishna, the family entertainer is scheduled to arrive in cinemas globally on October 9, 2026.

news.title: Prabhas Unveils Unconventional Story Glimpse for Gen-Z Centric Youth Film
news.summary: Rebel Star Prabhas has shared the story reveal video for the upcoming movie Romeo Juliet, directed by Bhargav Mucharla. Starring Harshit and Vishaka Dhiman, the youth-focused project satirizes modern dating dynamics like situationships and one-night stands through an unusual premise. Produced by Sundeep N and Venkateswara Rao Challagulla, the film is slated for release on October 23, coinciding with Prabhas' birthday.

news.title: Modern Dating Challenges Take Center Stage in Upcoming Youth Drama
news.summary: The upcoming film Romeo Juliet, starring Harshith and Vishaka Dhiman, aims to explore modern relationship terminology and contemporary romance among the youth. Directed by Bhargav Macharla, the project's unique narrative premise was recently introduced to audiences nearly a month ahead of its theatrical debut. Backed by Navarasa Entertainments and featuring music by Gopi Sundar, the movie hits theaters on October 23.

news.title: First Single From Venkatesh Starrer Brings Festive Energy to Screens
news.summary: The promotional rollout for Venkatesh's family entertainer Adarsha Kutumbam has begun with the launch of its debut single, Narayanamma. Composed by Thaman S, the dance track features performances from Venkatesh, Dimple Hayathi, Sreenidhi Shetty, and Nivetha Pethuraj. Directed by Trivikram Srinivas, the movie is set to release on October 9 under the Haarika & Hassine Creations banner.

news.title: Venkatesh and Trivikram's Aadarsha Kutumbam launches its debut track Narayanamma
news.summary: The upcoming Telugu film Aadarsha Kutumbam has released its first single titled Narayanamma, composed by Thaman with vocals by Prabha Bangarigalla and Ram Miriyala. Directed by Trivikram Srinivas and starring Venkatesh alongside Dimple Hayathi, the track features vibrant choreography and folk beats. The movie is scheduled to release on October 9, 2026.

news.title: Blockbuster Malayalam Rom-Com Bethlehem Kudumba Unit Locks OTT Premiere Date
news.summary: The Malayalam blockbuster Bethlehem Kudumba Unit, starring Nivin Pauly and Mamitha Baiju, is heading to digital platforms. Directed by Girish AD, the romantic comedy will make its streaming debut on JioHotstar on October 2, 2026, with availability in multiple languages including Telugu.

news.title: Nivin Pauly Starrer Bethlehem Kudumba Unit Confirms JioHotstar Streaming Release
news.summary: Following a successful theatrical run, Girish A.D.'s directorial Bethlehem Kudumba Unit has finalized its digital premiere. The Malayalam film starring Nivin Pauly and Mamitha Baiju will begin streaming on JioHotstar on October 2, 2026.

news.title: Suriya Advises Admirers to Ignore Digital Trolls
news.summary: Popular Tamil actor Suriya recently interacted with his fan club members and advised them to completely avoid online feuds. He encouraged his supporters to channel their energy into personal growth and daily hard work rather than answering critics on the internet.

news.title: Weighing the Massive Expectations Surrounding Jailer 2
news.summary: Rajinikanth's upcoming sequel Jailer 2 is generating enormous business targets ahead of its mid-October release. However, trade analysts note that the promotional campaign and recent musical singles have yet to fully match the massive pre-release hype of its predecessor.

news.title: Rajinikanth Starrer Dharman Targets Festival Release
news.summary: Superstar Rajinikanth's 173rd feature film Dharman is swiftly advancing under Ashwath Marimuthu's direction and Kamal Haasan's production. Featuring a notable cast that includes Ram Pothineni, the film is gearing up to lock horns at the box office during the Pongal 2027 window.

news.title: Speculation Grows Over Mahesh Babu's Next Cinematic Venture
news.summary: With SS Rajamouli's directorial Varanasi nearing completion ahead of its April 2027 release, discussions regarding Mahesh Babu's subsequent film are gaining momentum. Recent speculations have linked director Lokesh Kanagaraj to a potential future collaboration following a banner partnership announcement.

news.title: Nani and Director Address Dialogue Backlash in The Paradise
news.summary: Actor Nani and director Srikanth Odela recently spoke about a controversial dialogue in their latest release, The Paradise, which faced heavy trolling from viewers. The director explained that the line was meant to highlight ironic childhood talent, but the explanatory backstory was trimmed to shorten the runtime. Nani noted that cutting crucial setup scenes during editing often causes well-intentioned payoffs to be misunderstood by audiences.

news.title: Taapsee Pannu Embraces Retro Aesthetics in Latest Photoshoot
news.summary: Taapsee Pannu recently shared striking pictures from a new vintage-themed photoshoot, donning a black-and-gold floral dress and retro curls. Despite facing a challenging box office run this year with her recent releases, the actor continues filming for Woh Ladki Hai Kahaan?. Her career has been marked by resilience following earlier industry hurdles and casting challenges.

news.title: NTR Prepares to Join Dragon Set in Mumbai Next Month
news.summary: Actor NTR, who took a temporary break to recover from a shoulder injury, is scheduled to resume shooting for Dragon on October 10 in Mumbai. Director Prashanth Neel has continued filming non-NTR portions in the meantime, while a high-octane action sequence is planned for the upcoming two-week schedule. The big-budget action drama stars Rukmini Vasanth, Anil Kapoor, and Biju Menon alongside the lead actor.

news.title: Anil Ravipudi Nears Completion of January 12 Vidudala Shooting Schedule
news.summary: Director Anil Ravipudi is progressing swiftly with the production of January 12 Vidudala, with filming nearing its final phase following a brief production pause. The upcoming schedule includes shooting portions in Ooty and abroad before wrapping up principal photography by mid-November. The ensemble film features Venkatesh, Kalyanram, Keerthy Suresh, and Krithi Shetty in pivotal roles ahead of its January theatrical release.

news.title: Fresh Trailer Sparks Buzz for Upcoming Romantic Drama Chakkora
news.summary: The theatrical trailer for Chakkora – Lunar Love Bird has made its debut in Hyderabad, offering a blend of romance, family dynamics, and mystery. Starring Sravan and Malaika T. Vasupal, the film follows a carefree young man whose life turns upside down when his love interest suddenly vanishes. Directed by Manga Srinivas, the musical entertainer is slated to hit global theatres on October 9.

news.title: First-Look Visuals and Character Posters Unveiled for Epic Mythological Project Ramayana
news.summary: The ambitious mythological film Ramayana, directed by Nitesh Tiwari, has generated considerable excitement with fresh promotional stills featuring Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, and Ravi Dubey. Additionally, makers revealed the striking first look of Yash as the formidable antagonist Ravana, showcasing a regal and intense aura. Produced across two parts, the cinematic venture is scheduled for successive Diwali releases in 2026 and 2027.

news.title: Manga Srinivas Directorial Chakkora Unveils Narrative Twist in New Trailer
news.summary: Headlined by Sravan and Malaika T. Vasupal, the upcoming Telugu feature Chakkora has showcased a vibrant trailer highlighting youthful romance and unexpected suspense. The story transitions from a lighthearted love pursuit into an intriguing investigation after the female lead mysteriously disappears. Backed by High Joy Commercials and VIP – Vintage Iconic Pictures, the project features music composed by Prince Henry.

news.title: Nani Starrer The Paradise Pulls Strong Box Office Numbers Through Opening Weekend
news.summary: Despite encountering mixed initial reviews following its mid-week premiere, Nani's latest outing The Paradise has registered impressive box office figures. According to the production team, the Srikanth Odela directorial amassed a worldwide gross of 136 crore rupees in its first three days while maintaining solid momentum overseas. Strong advance bookings and positive word-of-mouth trends point to continued financial success heading into Sunday.

news.title: NTR Set to Resume Shooting for Dragon Following Injury Recovery
news.summary: Actor NTR is gearing up to head to Mumbai on October 10 for a 15-day shooting schedule for his pan-India project Dragon. The Prashanth Neel directorial will feature high-octane action sequences involving NTR and co-star Anil Kapoor. This marks NTR's return to sets after a nearly two-month hiatus due to shoulder surgery following an injury.

news.title: Nani Starrer The Paradise Faces Crucial Box Office Monday
news.summary: Nani's big-budget release The Paradise opened to massive numbers but drew mixed reactions regarding its screenplay and emotional depth. Trade estimates indicate the film accumulated roughly ₹120 crore gross by Saturday on its path toward a ₹220 crore target. Its box-office sustainability now hinges heavily on weekday collections starting Monday.

news.title: Fresh Character Posters Drop for Upcoming Epic Ramayana
news.summary: The makers of the Nitesh Tiwari directorial Ramayana have revealed striking new character posters showcasing Yash as Ravana alongside a serene trio poster of Ram, Lakshmana, and Sita. Backed by producers Namit Malhotra and Monster Mind Creations, the grand project is scheduled for a two-part release during Diwali 2026 and Diwali 2027.

news.title: Tabu to Be Introduced via Special Teaser in Nagarjuna's King100
news.summary: Nagarjuna's milestone film King100 is preparing to release a special promotional teaser highlighting Tabu's character. The project reunites Nagarjuna and Tabu on screen years after their 1990s blockbuster Ninne Pelladutha. Directed by Ra Karthik, the movie is scheduled to hit theaters on December 24, 2026.

news.title: Vijay Deverakonda and Team Launch Promotional Docuseries for Ranabaali
news.summary: The makers of Vijay Deverakonda's upcoming historical drama Ranabaali are releasing a four-part promotional docuseries titled Ranabaali: Never Forget. Directed by Rahul Sankrityan and produced by Mythri Movie Makers, the project draws on two years of research into 150 years of Rayalaseema history. The film is scheduled to hit the big screen on October 16, 2026.
